editions.title: This weekend in motorsport
editions.intro: A busy week of racing is ahead from 30 September to 5 October, with rounds in IMSA SportsCar Championship, Formula 1, MotoGP, NASCAR Cup Series, NHRA Drag Racing and the World Rally Championship.

items.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
items.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
items.body: The IMSA SportsCar Championship arrives at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta for the Motul Petit Le Mans on Sat 3 Oct.

items.headline: Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
items.detail: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: Formula 1 holds the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia on Sun 4 Oct at 07:00 UTC.

items.headline: Grand Prix of Japan
items.detail: Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The MotoGP Grand Prix of Japan is held at Mobility Resort Motegi on Sun 4 Oct.

items.headline: South Point 400
items.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The NASCAR Cup Series visits Las Vegas Motor Speedway for the South Point 400 on Sun 4 Oct.

items.headline: Midwest Nationals
items.detail: World Wide Technology Raceway, Illinois · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: NHRA Drag Racing brings the Midwest Nationals to World Wide Technology Raceway, Illinois on Sun 4 Oct.

items.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
items.detail: Alghero, Italy · Sun 4 Oct
items.body: The World Rally Championship travels to Alghero, Italy for Rally Italia Sardegna on Sun 4 Oct.

editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: A look back at the racing action from 22 to 28 September, covering rounds across Formula 1, Formula 2, NASCAR Cup Series, NHRA Drag Racing and the World Endurance Championship.

items.headline: Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sat 26 Sep
items.body: George Russell of Mercedes won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix at Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan, followed by Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar for Red Bull.

items.headline: Baku
items.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: Formula 2 arrived in Baku on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: Hollywood Casino 400
items.detail: Kansas Speedway · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: The NASCAR Cup Series visited Kansas Speedway for the Hollywood Casino 400 on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: Nationals at The Rock
items.detail: Rockingham Dragway, North Carolina · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: NHRA Drag Racing held the Nationals at The Rock at Rockingham Dragway, North Carolina, on Sunday 27 September.

items.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
items.detail: Fuji Speedway, Japan · Sun 27 Sep
items.body: Round seven of the World Endurance Championship took place at Fuji Speedway, Japan, for the 6 Hours of Fuji on Sunday 27 September.
